references.text: Continuation of the laws concerning leprosy in garments, detailing how the priest is to examine and handle the clothing.
Summary of the laws concerning leprosy, including leprosy in garments (beged).
Mentions woolen and linen garments, the same materials referred to in Leviticus 13:47.
Introduction to the term 'nega tsara'at' (leprous plague), which is also used for garments in verse 47.
Parallel use of 'nega tsara'at' applied to houses, corresponding to how it is applied to garments.
